## Summary

A brief description of the feature you'd like.

## Motivation

Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution

How do you think this should work? Include:
- UI behavior (if applicable)
- Which part of the codebase it touches (engine, levels, components)
- Any alternative approaches you considered

## Level Impact

Does this enable new level types or git commands? If so, which tier would they belong to?

## Would You Like to Implement This?

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to work on this
- [ ] No, I'm just suggesting it
